name: platypus
description: Platypus game launcher: React UI (apps/ui) and desktop shell (apps/desktop) around the Go core

scripts.typecheck: bun --filter platypus-ui typecheck && bun --filter platypus-desktop typecheck
scripts.test: bun run i18n:check && bun run test:ui && bun run test:desktop
scripts.test:slow: PLATYPUS_TEST_SLOW=1 go test ./... && PLATYPUS_TEST_SLOW=1 bun run test
scripts.test:network: PLATYPUS_TEST_NETWORK=1 go test ./... && PLATYPUS_TEST_NETWORK=1 bun run test:ui
scripts.test:all: PLATYPUS_TEST_SLOW=1 PLATYPUS_TEST_NETWORK=1 go test ./... && PLATYPUS_TEST_SLOW=1 PLATYPUS_TEST_NETWORK=1 bun run test
